scope: Partial four-pair PLACO candidate variants and candidate intervals only; protected Track B is absent.
interval_basis: chr6:25-34 Mb is a published extended-MHC sensitivity interval on GRCh37/hg19; this is an exclusion sensitivity, not a new discovery threshold.
candidate_definition: Use the existing checksum-verified partial candidate table, whose members were generated from QC-passed PLACO pair outputs at the frozen 1e-8 candidate threshold and existing LD-clumping rule.
position_policy: Only EXACT_MATCH variants in the frozen UK Biobank LAVA reference count as position-validated. Unmatched or position-mismatched rows are reported separately and never treated as outside-MHC.
interval_policy: A candidate interval is outside MHC only if its complete half-open [START, STOP) interval does not overlap the excluded interval.
inference_policy: Do not recompute P-values, q-values, thresholds, pair correction, or candidate membership. Report descriptive partial-family counts only; do not call candidates independent or causal loci.
